tools.name: check_resume_text
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to confirm that a resume PDF made from their facts has machine-readable text: it builds the same PDF as generate_resume_pdf from the same fields, reads the text back with pdf.js, and reports the page count, whether text runs top to bottom, and which headings and bullets
